ops.title: binary_supports probe primitive (promote cc-context ccx_supports pattern)
ops.description: Inventory (2026-07-18) counted 14 capability-probe sites across the family re-implementing "does this binary exist / support this flag" (cc-context's `ccx_supports` x14 being the largest cluster; captain-hook has `fs.resolve_binary` + ad-hoc probes). Promote a shared `binary_supports(name, flag)` / capability-probe primitive with caching, and adopt it at the inventoried sites. Candidate home: captain_hook.util.fs or a cc-family shared layer.
